normalization.unicode: NFKC on a COPY for comparison only; original bytes and offsets preserved separately
normalization.punctuation: every character not matched by the token regex is a boundary (apostrophes, hyphens, commas, periods, digits stay attached only inside a token run)
normalization.numbers: retained verbatim as tokens; never stripped, never converted
normalization.stopword-policy: a CLOSED list is removed from the CONTENT stream only; negations (no, not, never, none, nor, without, cannot) and hedges/qualifiers (may, might, could, reportedly, according, about, likely) are NEVER removed
normalization.variant-law: both surface forms map to the canonical token 'ashoka' on BOTH sides symmetrically; the surface forms are still counted separately for the record
normalization.phrases: bigrams (n=2) and trigrams (n=3) over the CONTENT-token stream in original order
normalization.duplicates: both TYPE-level (unique) and MULTISET counts are reported everywhere

overlap.shared-tokens-type: |A intersect B| over unique content tokens
overlap.shared-tokens-multiset: sum over tokens of min(count_A, count_B)
overlap.proportions: type-share of A, type-share of B, multiset-share of A, multiset-share of B
overlap.phrase-counts: shared unique bigrams and trigrams, with shares of each source's unique n-grams
overlap.floor: if shared unique content tokens < 10 the measurement is INSUFFICIENT-SIGNAL: raw counts only, NO similarity adjective is emitted
overlap.saturation: no score, however high, moves the word beyond TEXTUAL-SIMILARITY - similarity is not corroboration
overlap.topic-inflation: token overlap is recomputed with topic terms removed and BOTH results are reported, so common historical terminology cannot silently inflate the headline
overlap.denominators: every score is printed with its numerator and denominator

claims.unit: a clause-level factual proposition EXPLICITLY present in the held excerpt
rules: no external knowledge, memory or other sources
no upgrading a vague description into a precise claim
every excerpt must be re-locatable: text[offset_start:offset_end] == excerpt
if no clear proposition -> NON-CLAIM or AMBIGUOUS, never forced
claims.judgment-law: claim extraction is ANALYST JUDGMENT and is recorded as such; the deterministic layer is normalization + overlap only. Judgments are auditable (verbatim excerpt + offset), not presented as deterministic facts

comparison.material-equivalence: same subject AND predicate AND the same material qualifiers (entity identity, date/quantity value, polarity) within the held excerpts; a paraphrase that preserves all of these is equivalent
comparison.incompatibility: same subject and predicate with a contradictory value, polarity or attribution - not merely a different emphasis
comparison.PARTIAL: shared subject/predicate but a material detail differs OR is unsupported on one side
comparison.INDETERMINATE: a comparable subject exists but the held excerpts are too thin to decide
comparison.NO-MATCH: no comparable proposition was identified in the other source
comparison.rule: shared names or terminology alone NEVER constitute AGREEMENT; the proposition must match

corroboration.independence-law: different registrable domains are NOT independence; independence is UNKNOWN unless provenance in the held bytes establishes it
corroboration.ladder-disposition: DIVERSITY-ONLY stands unless condition 3 holds AND condition 4 is established; otherwise the word stays DIVERSITY-ONLY or drops to TEXTUAL-SIMILARITY / CLAIM-PARTIAL, never 'corroborated'

prohibitions: no threshold chosen after the result
no promotion of DIVERSITY-ONLY to corroboration
no modification of A42-A45 artifacts or manifests
no production code change beyond a narrowly scoped offline test
